name: a full pool renders one filled dot per point
temporary below permanent renders an empty dot for each spent point
temporary above permanent renders a ringed dot for each extra point, not clamped
temporary equal to permanent renders only filled dots
ten points group into two fives
eleven points stay eleven dots of one size, never a capital
a 15-point pool (e.g. Blood) is three groups of five
groups count every dot, whatever its state
twelve spent points group in fives
twelve points above zero permanent group in fives
held and spent together group across the change
